description: This reference locates single-phase motor with fan in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented 1 phase motors family. A single-phase motor with an associated fan identifies the driven function as well as the electrical load. Its schematic supply is separate from the airflow or installation detail. The public library uses HMO1M3M for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace each winding, supply and accessible neutral through the complete machine or transformer connection diagram. Keep the phase arrangement, terminal labels and any clock notation attached to the device; neither the convention label nor this educational outline supplies its ratings.
